tg.impact: Changing does not take effect at once: an approved rebind request runs after 24 hours (then a security event signs out every web session and the PIN and whitelist are cleared). Removing takes effect at once: security event, all web sessions signed out, withdrawals frozen. Both email the alert recipients.

autoReview.manualBannerSub: Check the rules in red below before approving or rejecting.
autoReview.precheckDiff: Pre-check at submission: {{result}}; data changed during cooling, the re-check above decides.
autoReview.snapshotNote: Values and thresholds are a snapshot at check time; later rule changes don't affect this record.
autoReview.reviewerAuto: Reviewed by: system auto-approval (all rules passed)

autoApprove.title: Auto-approval rules
autoApprove.sub: A withdrawal is approved automatically only when every enabled rule passes; any failure sends it to manual review
autoApprove.masterOnDesc: When the cooling period ends, the {{count}} enabled rules below are checked: all passed → approved automatically; any failure → manual review.
autoApprove.masterOffDesc: While off, every withdrawal goes to manual review (as today). Rules still run and are recorded for reviewers' reference. We suggest switching it on no earlier than 48 hours after launch (R6 needs password changes, which are recorded only from launch).
autoApprove.notLoosen: Rules only decide whether a person reviews; no limit is relaxed
autoApprove.notLoosenDesc: The 2-hour cooling period stays (auto-approved withdrawals are paid only after it); ≥ 3,000 USDT still waits 6 hours after approval; whitelist 24-hour activation and the 10,000 per withdrawal / 30,000 daily limits stay.
autoApprove.rulesSub: {{enabled}} of {{total}} enabled; disabled rules are not checked
autoApprove.errDecimals: Enter a number with at most {{n}} decimals
autoApprove.errR2LtR1: Must not be below the R1 single cap
autoApprove.errR3LtR2: Must not be below the R2 customer 24h cap
autoApprove.fixErrors: Fix the values in red first
autoApprove.saveDesc: {{count}} changes. Saving creates version {{version}}, effective for withdrawals whose cooling period ends from now on:
autoApprove.saveMasterOff: The master switch will be off: every withdrawal goes to manual review.
autoApprove.saved: Saved; new checks use the new rules
autoApprove.historySub: Also written to the audit log (high risk)

provider.title: Wallet provider
provider.sub: API status, available balance, deposit networks, switch history
provider.currentMissingTitle: The wallet provider in use, {{name}}, isn't connected
provider.currentMissingDesc: Its address and keys aren't fully configured on the server (TopUP: missing any of FX_TOPUP_BASE_URL, FX_TOPUP_API_KEY, FX_TOPUP_API_SECRET counts as not connected), so deposit addresses, deposits and withdrawals don't work. It takes effect once Amos fills them in with trading keys.
provider.placeholder: Reserved. Connected later once the account is opened.
provider.downDesc: Check that TopUP is running; everything resumes automatically once it recovers. Approved withdrawals wait and are not lost.
provider.networksHint: Closed networks are hidden from customers; deposits to addresses already issued are still credited.
provider.netOnDesc: Customers can choose {{network}} on the deposit page. Platform-wide setting.
provider.netOffDesc: Customers no longer see {{network}}; deposits to {{network}} addresses already issued are still credited. Platform-wide setting.
provider.impactNew: New networks chosen by new and existing customers get addresses from the new provider
provider.impactOld: Addresses already issued keep being credited
provider.impactPayout: Withdrawals in progress are paid by the original provider
provider.switchConfirm: High-risk operation. I have checked the impact above.
provider.alertLineTbd: Not set yet (no number decided, TY-6). Once set, staff are emailed when the balance falls below it.
provider.auditsEmpty: No history yet. Network toggles and provider switches are recorded here

quote.gateOnDesc: External keys work, but only for symbols with a resale license.
quote.gateOffDesc: While OFF only internal test keys and the trading app work; external keys can be created but calls are rejected (403).
quote.secretTitle: The secret is shown only once
quote.secretWarn: ⚠ You won't see it again after closing
quote.secretWarnDesc: Copy it now and hand it to the client securely. Neither this page nor the API can show it again; if lost, rotate the key.
quote.copied: Secret copied. Clear your clipboard after handing it over.
quote.secretGateOff: The public access switch is OFF, so this key can't be used yet.
quote.secretSaved: I have copied and saved it
quote.secretSavedRequired: Please confirm you have saved it
quote.keysSub: Quote API clients and keys; the secret is shown only once
quote.newClientDesc: No self sign-up or client portal in v1; clients are created here.
quote.clientCreated: Client created. Next: create a key for it
quote.newKeyDesc: Uses the default limits: REST {{rps}}/s and {{daily}}/day, {{ws}} WebSocket connections, up to {{syms}} symbols each.
quote.kindInternalLong: Internal test (not affected by the switch)
quote.kindExternalLong: External (usable only when the switch is ON and the symbol has a resale license)
quote.symbolsHint: Comma-separated; leave empty for all licensed symbols
quote.rotateDesc: Creates a new key (new secret shown once) and disables the old one at once: within 5 s its API calls return 401 and WebSockets are closed. Use this when a key leaks.
quote.rotated: Rotated; the old key is disabled
quote.disableDesc: Within 5 s after disabling, this key's API calls return 401 and its WebSockets are closed.
quote.encNotReady: The server has no secret encryption key (FX_QUOTE_KEY_ENC_KEY) yet, so keys can't be created. Ask Amos to set it in the platform console.
quote.noClientDesc: No self sign-up in v1. Before resale licenses and the public switch, internal test keys are enough.
quote.keysFoot: Within 5 s after disabling or rotating, the old key gets 401 and its WebSockets close. Change limits under "Limits & usage".
quote.usageSub: Metered per key, per day and per symbol
quote.freeDesc: No bills, prices or online payment in v1; pricing will be decided by Amos later.
quote.usageHeroDesc: Ops get an email at 80%; above the limit only the extra requests are rejected. Adjust this key only on the right.
quote.defaultsHint: New keys use these defaults; changing them doesn't affect existing keys.
quote.noUsage: No usage yet; it shows up per day once keys are used
quote.limitDesc: Only this key changes; other keys and defaults stay. Takes effect within 1 minute.
quote.limitSaved: Limits saved; effective for this key within 1 minute
quote.defaultDesc: Affects keys created from now on only; existing keys stay unchanged.
quote.defaultSaved: Defaults saved; new keys will use them
quote.keep13: Daily (UTC), kept for 13 months. Pushes and connected time are recorded per key and symbol.
quote.licenseSub: Two gates: public access switch + provider × symbol licenses
quote.licenseDesc: Tick each use separately. Only presence, dates and a note are kept; no contract text or prices.
quote.symbolInvalid: Use an uppercase symbol code, or * for all symbols of this provider
quote.notePh: Don't enter contract text or prices
quote.expiryHeroDesc: License check is ON: from the end date it's treated as unlicensed (symbols without trading use are display-only). Renew after signing.
quote.notTradableTitleOff: Symbols without a trading license (record only: the license check is off, these symbols trade normally)
quote.licenseHintOff: License check is OFF (off in every environment by default, Amos 11/17): the three uses (trading, display after login, resale) are recorded only and don't affect trading, display or external keys. Only presence, dates and a note are kept; no contract text or prices. Ops are still emailed 30 days before expiry. They only apply once ops set FX_QUOTE_LICENSE_ENFORCE=true.
quote.expiryHeroDescOff: License check is OFF: expiry is a reminder only and doesn't affect trading or external keys. Renew after signing.
quote.noLicenseDescOff: License check is OFF (off in every environment by default, Amos 11/17): trading works without any license and external keys get all symbols (still limited by each key's own list). This page is a record only; register licenses here for reference once signed.
quote.noLicenseDesc: License check is ON: symbols without trading use are display-only and external keys get nothing. Register licenses here once Amos signs them.
quote.gateOffLong: OFF by default. Only internal test keys and the trading app work; external keys get 403 and WebSocket handshakes are rejected.
quote.licenseHint: License check is ON and each use applies: trading (can it trade at its prices), display after login, and resale (can external keys get it). Only presence, dates and a note are kept; no contract text or prices. Ops are emailed 30 days before expiry. Public display on the website isn't covered by these three.
quote.notTradableTitle: Symbols without a trading license (display-only when the license check is on; clients see "Not open for trading")
quote.superOnlyTip: Only a super admin can change the public switch.
quote.gateCloseDesc: External keys are rejected at once (403) and their WebSockets close; internal test keys and the trading app are unaffected.
quote.gateL3Desc: Turning it on means offering the quote service in the company's name. Make sure Amos has explicitly approved and resale licenses are registered.
quote.gateOpenDesc: After turning on, external keys work, but only for symbols with a resale license.
quote.gateReason: Reason (required: when Amos approved; goes into the audit log)
quote.amosRequired: Can't turn on without Amos's approval
quote.amosAgreed: Amos has approved turning it on
quote.sourcesSub: Provider in use per symbol, last quote, switches and deviations in 24 h
quote.srcDownHero: No quotes from primary or backup: {{list}}
quote.srcDownHeroDesc: Alert email sent. Trading rejects new positions and external clients see "no quote"; recovers automatically.
quote.srcDevHeroDesc: Closing, TP/SL and liquidation continue; external output keeps the primary price with a deviation status. Recovers automatically.
quote.noFeeds: No providers configured. Without a token a provider is treated as absent; the test environment uses simulated quotes labelled "sample". Tokens are set by Amos in the platform console.
quote.simulatedHint: No providers configured: the test environment uses simulated (sample) quotes.
quote.srcRule: Rules: switch to backup after 10 s without quotes, back after 30 s of recovery; opening paused when providers differ by > 0.5%. Production only trades on sources with a trading-use license.

recoveries.title: Recovery requests
recoveries.sub: Manual Telegram rebinds and manual PIN resets for customers without email. Reviewed by Amos alone: approving needs a verification note and your admin password; rebinds run 24 hours and PIN resets 48 hours after approval.
recoveries.disputeRule: Disputed: the original Telegram tapped "Not me".
recoveries.revokeRequested: {{time}} the original Telegram asked to cancel. Cancellations of rebinds always go to you (dispute or not): approval and execution pause and the freeze stays. Verify by video, then choose Cancel or Keep

action.revoke_after_keep: Holder cancelled again (already kept; no pause)

recoveries.approveImpactRebind: The account moves to the applicant's new Telegram 24 hours after approval: PIN and whitelist cleared, withdrawals paused 48 hours, all web sessions signed out. The original Telegram can cancel during the wait (disputed requests go to you).
recoveries.approveImpactPin: Takes effect 48 hours after approval: the old PIN stops working, the whitelist is cleared and withdrawals pause for 48 hours. The customer can cancel during the wait.
recoveries.proofNote: Verification note (source address / shared app screen / P2P, etc.)
recoveries.passwordHint: Approving or keeping needs your own admin password. Wrong entries count with login failures and lock the account and sign you out at the limit.
recoveries.rejectImpact: The applicant's Telegram account is banned (long term); later requests from it are refused.
recoveries.revokeImpact: Your own cancellation takes effect immediately: the request closes and any freeze it caused is lifted.
recoveries.keepImpact: Clears the cancellation request; the rebind runs at its scheduled time. Verify the original holder by video first.
recoveries.kept: {{time}} you already kept this once: further cancellations by the original Telegram are only logged and alerted; they no longer pause approval or execution.
recoveries.depositsHint: Check the paying address on the explorer. A qualified source address is older than 30 days before the request and older than the last security event, has no exchange label, is not shared (sent to more than 20 addresses in 90 days), and no new paying address appeared in the last 30 days (page 08 section 0).
